must: Run entirely from local extension assets
Remain usable on mobile and desktop

decisions.decision: Use a calm, sustainability-led analytics direction inspired by the reference: pale aqua header, spacious metric typography, subtle borders, and a cyan area chart.
decisions.reason: Keeps the dashboard modern and trustworthy while emphasizing the savings figures.

decisions.decision: Use a compact pale-aqua extension popup with a persistent top-level toggle, two all-time metric cards, and a high-contrast dashboard action.
decisions.reason: Extends the dashboard visual language into Chrome while keeping the primary controls immediately scannable.

decisions.decision: Replace illustrative dashboard figures with local measured routing counts and clearly separated modeled cost/carbon estimates, including 7-day, 30-day, and 365-day history views.
decisions.reason: Prevents sample projections from being mistaken for telemetry while preserving useful impact trends.
